prerequisites.title: Kintone domain admin access
prerequisites.detail: Creating an OAuth client needs access to User & System Administration in the Kintone domain.

prerequisites.title: Composio auth config with your own credentials
prerequisites.detail: Create the auth config with the client ID and secret, using the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

steps.title: Register OAuth client in Kintone
steps.detail: In System Administration, open OAuth, click Add OAuth Client, enter a client name and redirect endpoint, then save.
steps.done_when: Client ID, client secret and endpoints are shown.

steps.title: Enable client for users
steps.detail: Use Configure users to select who may use the client; new users are unchecked by default.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API with the client ID and secret.

steps.title: Set scopes and test authorization
steps.detail: Request needed scopes separated by spaces and check the redirect URI is URL-encoded and matches.
steps.done_when: User clicks Allow and a token is returned.

traps.title: Users disabled by default
traps.detail: A new client and newly created users have the OAuth client disabled until an admin checks them.

traps.title: IP-restricted domains block OAuth
traps.detail: OAuth clients cannot be used from domains with IP restrictions unless the client's IP is allowlisted.

traps.title: 20-client cap and token limits
traps.detail: A domain holds up to 20 OAuth clients, and 10 refresh tokens per client per user. Access tokens last 1 hour.

traps.title: Scopes are not set in the console
traps.detail: Scopes go in the authorization request, and tokens only call APIs in scope.

blockers.what_it_means: The admin has not enabled the OAuth client for that user.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the domain admin to check the user in Configure users.

blockers.what_it_means: Authorization codes last 10 minutes and access tokens 1 hour.
blockers.what_to_do: Exchange codes quickly and refresh access tokens.
